quick: Men do best with a light, non-greasy face cream that suits their skin type, applied after washing and shaving, with sunscreen on top every morning. A simple routine in India is face wash, cream and sunscreen in the morning, and face wash plus cream at night.
facts: A pea-sized amount of cream is enough for the face.
Choose a face cream by skin type, not by gender.
Apply cream after a cool rinse once you have shaved.
Mirc Glow creams do not contain SPF, so use separate sunscreen.
